quotes.author: ANA OROZCO
quotes.text: We had an amazing experience with Aviwatersport yesterday on our tour of the 10,000 Islands! 🌴🐬 The tour was absolutely wonderful, and one of the highlights was being able to see dolphins swimming very close to us. It was such a beautiful and unforgettable experience! Everything was well organized, and the tour was enjoyable from beginning to end. We had a fantastic time and would definitely recommend Aviwatersport to anyone looking for a fun and memorable way to explore the 10,000 Islands. Thank you for an incredible day! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

quotes.author: Stacie Plunkett
quotes.text: Rosie took us out on an amazing afternoon tour. We saw so many areas that we had never been able to get to in our boat. Rosie provided a thorough safety training before and made sure we were all comfortable throughout the tour. We loved seeing all the Dolphin and sites. This is definitely the best tour around Marco. Thank you Avi’s Water Sports and Rosie fir an unforgettable afternoon!

quotes.author: Tabitha Spillers
quotes.text: Hands down the best experience we've had and Rosie was AMAZING! She went out of her way to ensure we had a great adventure, saw Dolphins, while teaching us about the Mangroves. We even got lucky enough to see a stingray jumped out of the water! We will absolutely book this adventure again on our next vacation to Marco Island.

quotes.author: L Maldonado
quotes.text: Rosie was absolutely outstanding!! She is very professional and knowledgeable about the 10,000 islands. She made sure I was able to meet a few dolphins and a crocodile out of the blue. I will book a jet ski tour again!!! Thank you for an amazing experience!!!

quotes.author: Jeff Pistritto
quotes.text: Avi did a great job of the 10000 island tour and with capturing the dolphins. We got so close to a dolphin pod as well. We highly recommend Avi's Watersports for the dolphins and the 10000 island tour!

quotes.author: Claire McGilberry
quotes.text: Absolutely amazing experience!! Rosie was our instructor and was the best! Saw so much wildlife throughout our tour and lots of dolphins. 10/10 would do again and we recommend Rosie!
